modules.name: context
modules.responsibility: WebGL2RenderingContext acquisition, extension detection (OES_texture_float_linear, EXT_color_buffer_half_float), capability profiling, and context loss handling.

modules.name: resources
modules.responsibility: 3D texture allocation (gl.texStorage3D/gl.texSubImage3D), 1D Depth LUT texture/UBO management, colormap transfer function texture, pixel unpack alignment, and memory tracking under 50 MiB limit.

modules.name: shaders
modules.responsibility: GLSL ES 3.00 volume raymarching shader programs, Smits-Kay ray-AABB slab intersection, Beer-Lambert step-size opacity correction, transfer function evaluation, and empty-space skipping.

modules.name: pipeline
modules.responsibility: VAO management, uniform buffer updates, framebuffer management, viewport binding, and draw call orchestration for volume raymarching.

modules.name: picking
modules.responsibility: Single-pixel picking pass via gl.readPixels to offscreen FBO, returning normalized volume coordinates [u, v, w] and scalar values for ProvisionalPickMapper reconciliation.

r16f.role: Primary scientific scalar volume texture for half-float temperature data. Hardware filtered when OES_texture_float_linear is available; software trilinear interpolation in GLSL ES 3.00 fallback path.

r16ui.role: Quantized 16-bit unsigned integer scalar texture ([0, 65534] valid, 65535 reserved missing). In-shader affine de-quantization (scalar = float(raw) * scale + offset) with manual 8-tap trilinear interpolation.

r8ui.role: Categorical validity mask (1u = valid ocean water, 0u = masked/land/nodata). Nearest point-sampled in GLSL ES 3.00 for empty-space skipping before transfer function evaluation.

transfer_function.role: 256x1 RGBA transfer function lookup texture mapping normalized physical scalar [0, 1] to color and opacity.

depth_lut.role: 1D depth LUT (or uniform array) holding 31 non-uniform Copernicus standard vertical depth levels (0.494m to 453.938m) for piecewise linear vertical coordinate reconstruction.

glsl_es_300_raymarching_architecture.precision: precision highp float; precision highp int; precision highp sampler3D; precision highp usampler3D;
glsl_es_300_raymarching_architecture.volume_space: Normalized volume coordinates [u, v, w] in [0, 1]^3
glsl_es_300_raymarching_architecture.aabb_intersection: Smits-Kay ray-AABB slab intersection returning tNear and tFar clipped to camera near plane (tNear = max(0.0, tNear))

analytical_clipping.evaluation: Slab intersection interval clamped against [uClipMin, uClipMax]

depth_lut_interpolation.algorithm: Piecewise continuous linear interpolation across 31 discrete Copernicus levels
depth_lut_interpolation.index_formula: continuousIndex = clamp(w * float(depthCount - 1), 0.0, float(depthCount - 1)); frac = continuousIndex - floor(continuousIndex);

empty_space_skipping.semantics: maskVal == 0u -> skip TF evaluation and accumulate no opacity; maskVal == 1u -> valid ocean sample (including physical 0.0°C)

webgl2_picking_architecture.readback_method: gl.readPixels from offscreen RGBA32F or RGBA8 Framebuffer (1x1 pixel picking pass at cursor NDC)
